artifacts.00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000032:
# A small tool library, tested first

Pilot a shared tool shelf at the community center with a reservation notebook and a weekly volunteer shift.

## Why this proposal

A small pilot tests demand and maintenance effort before committing to a larger collection.

## Alternatives considered

- A mobile collection reaches more people but requires transport.
- A dedicated premises offers more space but increases fixed costs.

## Tradeoffs and assumptions

This needs dependable volunteers and secure storage. Demand and replacement costs remain unverified. Start with hand tools and exclude equipment requiring specialist training.

## Next steps

1. Interview ten neighbors about tools they would borrow.
2. Agree on storage, opening times and a replacement budget.
3. Run a six-week pilot and review borrowing and maintenance records.
